settings.heading: Brunch, ready when you are
settings.text: Order ahead, pick a time, and collect at the counter. Or have it brought to your villa within 5 km.

settings.title: Build your plate
settings.text: Pick your eggs and bread, add bacon or avocado. Allergies go in the kitchen note.

settings.title: Choose a time
settings.text: Every 15 minutes from 08:00. Times the kitchen can't cook for don't show up.

settings.title: Collect or relax
settings.text: Your name is on the bag at the counter. Or a rider brings it to you.

settings.heading: The menu
settings.text: Everything is cooked to order. Choose your eggs, your bread and what goes on top.

settings.heading: The beans behind every flat white
settings.text: Kintamani and Flores arabica, roasted weekly in Canggu. Ships across Indonesia.

settings.heading: Brunch for someone else
settings.text: Sent by email in a minute. Works online and at the counter.

settings.heading: Brunch for the whole villa
settings.text: Shared boards and a coffee cart for 15 to 120 guests. Ask for a quote; pay the deposit online.
